definitions.all_1p_options: Total ordinary-attention mass to all four first-presentation option lines.
definitions.matching_1p_option: Ordinary-attention mass to the first-presentation line containing the same semantic candidate.
definitions.matching_selectivity: Matching-line mass minus the mean mass to one nonmatching 1P option line.
definitions.query: Every token in each complete 2P option line, averaged over tokens, heads, and the four candidate ranks.
